acceptance: When release admission refuses a commit because it has no push run, the message names the nearest develop commit that has a successful run
A test with a replaced commit proves the message and that admission still fails closed
context: Introduced by the trunk-develop concurrency group (trunk.yml) and documented in docs/internal/release-artifacts.md and _project/decisions/trunk-latest-head-runs-2026-10-30.md as 'release from the newest tested head'. The doc states the rule but no tool enforces or helps with it.
description: Since develop pushes share one Trunk group, a push replaced while waiting gets no run and no dist-<sha>-attempt-N artifact, and release admission fails closed for it. The failure message does not point to the newest tested ancestor or descendant, so the releaser has to search by hand.
